title: Feature: every agent gets a short, unique, stable code name, shown at the far right of its row in the terminal UI's pro…
summary: Only the registry side of code names is done, and it is untested. Nothing is drawn in the terminal UI yet, and I didn't get to hit-testing, the tests or the docs. The one check I ran is `cargo check -p aura-app -p aura-ui -p aura-ui-terminal -p aura-desktop --all-targets`, which compiles clean. I have not run `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` or `cargo test`.
